name: Feasts Of Trumpets The
overview: The Feasts of Trumpets, observed on the first day of the seventh month, is a sacred assembly marked by rest and solemn remembrance, highlighted by the blowing of trumpets. Scripture details specific offerings made during this feast, including burnt offerings of a young bullock, a ram, and seven lambs without blemish, accompanied by meat offerings and a sin offering to atone for the people. These sacrifices, made by fire as a pleasing aroma to the LORD, underscore the feast's role as a holy convocation dedicated to worship and atonement.
